To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) combining adaptive passage retrieval and relevance models is effective; 2) the robust relevance model outperforms the Lavrenko–Croft relevance model in most cases; and 3) the robust relevance performs best with a combination of passage-level and full-length document-level information.

(i) the proposed adaptive passage retrieval approach improves document ranking with relevance models, particularly the robust relevance model, on three TREC collections; (ii) the robust relevance model performs consistently better than the Lavrenko- Croft relevance model in full-text and adaptive passage retrieval.
combining passage retrieval and relevance feedback improves document retrieval performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
improving relevance models for document retrieval by combining them with adaptive passage retrieval.
the problem of improving document retrieval with relevance models and adaptive passage retrieval.
the problem of how to combine the best passage of each document with relevance models to further improve document retrieval performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
adaptive passage retrieval is a useful technique to improve document ranking based on relevance models.
adaptive passage retrieval with the robust relevance model is the best approach to improving document retrieval.
the proposed adaptive passage retrieval method, in combination with relevance models, improves document retrieval in general, particularly when the collection is heterogeneous.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the robust relevance model is more effective in document retrieval than the Lavrenko–Croft relevance model.
the proposed approach is a good candidate for improving document retrieval with relevance models.
relevance models and pseudo relevance feedback are effective for improving document retrieval, and combining them with passage retrieval brings added benefits.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed approach can be used to improve relevance model based document retrieval in general.
the proposed passage ranking method can be applied to different relevance models to improve retrieval performance.
relevance models can be effectively enhanced by incorporating adaptive passage retrieval.
